name: kafka-connect-oracle-cdc
title: OSO CDC Connector for Oracle Database
description: Apache-2.0 change data capture source connector for Oracle Database, built on LogMiner. Exactly-once delivery aligned to Oracle transactions, durable transaction journal, bounded memory with spill to disk, SCN-anchored resumable snapshots and multi-PDB capture. Drop-in replacement for Confluent Oracle CDC Source and Debezium Oracle.

support.summary: Community support through GitHub issues; enterprise support subscriptions from OSO (see SUPPORT.md).

requirements: Oracle Database 19c or later with ARCHIVELOG mode and supplemental logging
